### Checklist

- [ ] Added YAML file to `src/data/projects/`
- [ ] Filename matches project slug (e.g., `my-project.yml`)
- [ ] All required fields are filled in
- [ ] Project has a public repo or website
- [ ] Project itself is a runnable AI agent like OpenClaw or Hermes. Tools that extend, host or manage another agent do not qualify.
- [ ] Not a duplicate of an existing entry

- [ ] For a new agent: include its upstream `quick_start` and a concrete `first_task`.
